biggest_catch: Key Select Checking carries a $25 monthly maintenance fee (waived only the first 3 months); the $500 bonus requires $5,000 in qualifying ACH direct deposits within 90 days - a meaningful payroll commitment.
catches: Must open a Key Select Checking account by 12/11/26 at 11:59 p.m. EST; offer redeemable online only.
Minimum opening deposit of $50; $25 monthly maintenance fee (waived first 3 months, avoidable afterward per fee schedule).
Must make $5,000+ in eligible ACH direct deposits within 90 days of account opening (payroll, Social Security, pension, government benefits).
Teller/ATM/mobile-app deposits do NOT count as qualifying direct deposits.
Not available to individuals who were a primary account owner of a KeyBank personal checking account in the last 12 months.
Limit one account-opening gift per qualifying account and one per individual.
Account must not be closed at the time of gift payment.
KeyBank employees/affiliates not eligible; geographic restrictions apply; account opening subject to approval.
Offer subject to cancellation without notice.

steps: Open a Key Select Checking account online by 12/11/2026 at 11:59 p.m. EST (branch required if non-resident).
Fund the account with at least $50.
Within 90 days, make a total of $5,000 or more in eligible ACH direct deposits (payroll, Social Security, pension, or government benefits).
Keep the account open through gift payment.
Receive the $500 bonus deposited within 60 days of meeting requirements.
timing: Bonus deposited within 60 days of meeting requirements. Offer expires 12/11/2026 (~79 days from check date).
when_cash_arrives: Bonus $500. Per official terms: Bonus deposited within 60 days of meeting requirements. Offer expires 12/11/2026 (~79 days from check date). Earliest realistic: ~74 days (first payroll DD ~2 weeks + up to 2 months); the 90-day window is an outer limit.
maximize: Fastest honest path. The gating item is almost always your payroll cycle. Fastest honest path: open online today and switch a real payroll/government direct deposit immediately — employer payroll changes take 1–2 pay cycles, so start now; Zelle, bank-to-bank transfers, and microdeposits usually don't count as direct deposit. After the qualifying deposits post, the bank's payout window is fixed and nothing speeds it up.
